en: Oh, it's you...
The guy they disfigured.
Are you looking for the Map too? The one that shows the way to the sewers?
Afraid I got bad news for you.
They caught up with Number 4 before he could escape!
He's rotting away in the high security sector in the Promenade!
Sucks, right?
"High security prisoners"
This guy's throat was slit.
And a whole bunch of rodents picked him to the bone.
Doesn't seem to have been used for a long time.
Well, well.
There's something hidden underneath.
Digging gear and some rope.
Is it just me, or were all the prisoners in here equipped with picks and shovels?
"Die, you selfish dog"
A poignant appeal for altruism.
Every knife in the prison seems to have ended up in his body.
Shit, and the spoons too.
They really had it in for him.
Nothing in his pockets.
A message left by the corpse over there.
"So everyone wants to get their hands on MY map of the sewers, do they?"
"Good luck finding it in the cesspool, losers!"
Asshole.
Nothing there, except the remains of a badly digested meal.
If there ever was anything here, it's gone down the tubes by now.
Hmm, why is the King willing to dig this deep just to get crystals?
Maybe he was selling them...
Or maybe he just likes pretty rocks.
Some of the villagers surely managed to get crystals to sell...
... They won't need it anymore, anyway.
A... table.
Nothing else, and I don't really want to try what's left on the plate.
Icy cold air is coming up from this hole overlooking an abyss...
Some strange rumblings, too...
A faithful likeness of the King.
"To the glory of our illustrious ruler."
Someone added something underneath:
"We'll skin you alive!"
A brave and courageous message.
Someone left a cow's head here.
Whoever it was, he was a bit of an artist.
He carefully traced the King's coat of arms on the animal’s forehead.
A statue of the King of the island.
...How could he see anything with that helmet on?
Another statue of the King, accompanied by a guard...
...and a very big one, at that.
A little too big, maybe?
A statue of the King, vandalized by his citizens.
There's a bunch of things scrawled on here.
...More complaints, I'll bet...
"THE KING IS LYING! DEATH TO THE KING! DEATH TO THE KING!"
There you go. I knew it.
Seriously? The King left one of his statues here?
Is there no end to his ego?
Better than nothing!
Funny, they look a little like... Me...
I always wondered what they did with the bodies.
I'm torn between a great sense of accomplishment and profound chagrin.
Did he really carry all that on his back?
Hard to see how you could "reforge" a grenade or a bow with a tool like that.
Very slipshod game design.
Bits and pieces of weapons and armor.
Hey, I recognize some of this!
Hmm, looks like the prisoner managed to get out of prison early.
... Left his bag behind him... must have been in quite a panic.
It sure is convenient finding all these messages on the walls!
Lore on a shoestring...
The writing is barely legible:
"Don't want... contaminated... out of here... see you again. I hope...
The "Malaise"...
...not infected...
won't die"
An order from the King, probably for his officers.
"Anyone presenting behavioral disorders or noticeable physical deteriorations must be imprisoned immediately."
I'll get more use out of this than the guards will.
Another order from the King to his officers.
"If the cells are overpopulated, use the outdoor jails or the oubliettes. Leave no suspects unsupervised."
Hmm, another order to the officers...
"The graveyard is full. Transfer the bodies directly to the ossuary and set fire to them immediately!"
Sounds like they were making it up as they went along.
"Order to be passed on to your soldiers under pain of death.
"Make sure to keep the portcullis down! You know as well as I do that they attack every night at around midnight!"
Something has been hidden behind the curtain...
"To all soldiers.
Anyone who fails to obey the king's orders will be hanged on the spot!"
Right, well, at least it's clear!
OK, it may be wrong to rummage through stuff that isn't mine...
...but they're all dead anyway.
Several identical messages, all stamped with the King's seal.
"Citizens! Anyone behaving strangely or manifesting signs of illness must be reported to the local patrol promptly and without exception."
There's something written under one of the signs:
"Anyone: That means EVERYONE!"
Several more public messages stamped with the King's seal.
"Citizens! If a patrol asks you to follow them, do not attempt to resist.
The common good takes precedence over the individual."
Something painted on the banner...
